title: 第0009章 紫芝破腹红雨洗魂第0010章 坟头听曲人鬼同途
lines: 那雨不是落下来的，是泼下来的。
像是天穹被人捅了个窟窿，天河里的水混着陈年的淤血，一股脑地往这干裂的耙耧山上倒。
雪见站在堂屋门口，整个人像是被抽去了脊梁骨，软塌塌地靠在门框上。她眼睁睁看着院子里那口平日里用来腌咸菜的大陶缸，在短短半盏茶的功夫里，就被染成了触目惊心的猩红。
那不是水。
雪见的鼻尖抽动了一下，一股浓烈得化不开的铁锈味、腥膻味，顺着湿冷的风直往她天灵盖里钻。那是血，是成千上万吨的鲜血，把这片干渴了百年的土地浇了个透。
一声凄厉的尖叫划破了雨幕，那是隔壁二婶的声音。
雪见浑身一激灵，她看见二婶正跌跌撞撞地从屋里跑出来，手里端着一个豁了口的粗瓷碗。二婶仰着头，张大嘴巴去接天上的雨水，可当那红色的液体流进嘴里时，她愣住了。
二婶低下头，看着碗里那浓稠如浆的液体，又抬起手摸了摸满脸的猩红。
“血……是血啊！”二婶的声音变了调，像是被人掐住了脖子的鸡，“老天爷杀人了！老天爷杀人了啊！”
碗摔在地上，碎片混着红水溅了一地。
雪见的腿肚子开始转筋，那股子腥气像是活物一样，顺着她的毛孔往里钻，钻进她的血管，要把她也变成这红色地狱的一部分。她下意识地后退，脚后跟却绊到了门槛，整个人狼狈地摔进屋里。
屋内的阴影里，半夏坐在炕沿上。
借着窗外偶尔划过的惨白闪电，雪见看见儿子的脸。半夏没有像往常那样喊渴，也没有像其他孩子那样哭闹。他只是静静地看着窗外，那双原本黑白分明的眼睛，此刻竟然也泛着淡淡的绿光。
“娘，雨是甜的。”半夏伸出舌头，舔了舔嘴唇，嘴角勾起一抹诡异的笑，“草在喝血，树在吃肉，我也饿了。”
“别说了！别说了！”雪见疯了一样扑过去，用那只长满藤蔓的左手死死捂住半夏的嘴。
掌心传来一阵剧痛，那是藤蔓上的刺扎进了肉里。可雪见顾不上疼，她惊恐地发现，随着红雨的落下，她掌心的藤蔓竟然在疯狂地蠕动、生长，那些细小的根须像是闻到了腥味的蚂蟥，争先恐后地想要钻进半夏的皮肤里。
“它们在高兴……”半夏的声音从指缝里漏出来，闷闷的，带着一股子不属于孩童的苍老，“娘，你的草在吃我的肉，我的肉在养你的草。咱们……终于长在一起了。”
雪见触电般地缩回手，瘫坐在地上，大口大口地喘着粗气。
窗外，雷声滚滚，像是无数冤魂在云层上擂鼓。红雨越下越大，把整个药王沟淹没在一片血色之中。
村西头的乱葬岗，此刻却安静得有些诡异。
青黛撑着一把黑色的油纸伞，静静地伫立在一座无主的荒坟前。
红雨打在伞面上，发出“笃笃”的闷响，像是有人在她耳边敲着丧钟。雨水顺着伞沿流下来，在伞边形成了一圈红色的珠帘，将她与这个疯狂的世界隔绝开来。
她低头看着面前这株紫芝。
在红雨的浇灌下，这株紫芝已经彻底长疯了。它不再是昨天那副半人高的模样，而是像吹了气一样膨胀起来，足有一个成年人那么高。紫黑色的菌盖层层叠叠，像是一顶繁复而华丽的皇冠，又像是一颗硕大无比、正在搏动的心脏。
青黛缓缓蹲下身，伸出那只涂着鲜红指甲油的手，轻轻抚摸着紫芝粗糙的表面。
触感温热，甚至能感觉到下面有液体在流动。
“你也饿了吧？”青黛轻声呢喃，声音里带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖。
她看着这株紫芝，就像是在照镜子。
这株紫芝长在这乱葬岗里，吸着死人的骨气，喝着活人的血雨，拼命地往上长，想要冲破这该死的泥土，想要看看外面的世界。
这多像她自己啊。
青黛想起了城里的日子。那些高楼大厦，那些灯红酒绿，还有那些穿着西装革履、满嘴仁义道德却干着吃人不吐骨头勾当的男人们。她就像这株紫芝一样，在那座钢筋水泥的森林里拼命扎根，拼命汲取养分，哪怕把自己变得面目全非，也要活下去，要活得比谁都好。
content_en:
The rain didn't fall, it poured.
It was as if someone had poked a hole in the sky, and the water in the Milky Way, mixed with old blood, was pouring down the dry and cracked mountain.
Xuejian stood at the door of the main room, his whole body seemed to have had his backbone removed, and he was leaning limply against the door frame. She watched helplessly as the large pottery vat in the yard, usually used for pickling pickles, was dyed a shocking scarlet color in just half a cup of tea.
That's not water.
The tip of Xuejian's nose twitched, and a strong smell of rust and fishy smell that could not be resolved went straight into her Tianling Gai along with the cold and wet wind. That was blood, tens of thousands of tons of blood, drenching this land that had been thirsty for hundreds of years.
"Ah——!"
A shrill scream cut through the rain curtain. It was the voice of the second aunt next door.
Xue Jian's whole body trembled. She saw her second aunt stumbling out of the house, holding a chipped porcelain bowl in her hand. The second aunt raised her head and opened her mouth wide to catch the rain from the sky, but when the red liquid flowed into her mouth, she was stunned.
The second aunt lowered her head, looked at the thick liquid in the bowl, and then raised her hand to touch the scarlet color on her face.
"Blood...it's blood!" The second aunt's voice changed its tone, like a chicken being strangled by the neck, "God has killed someone! God has killed someone!"
The bowl fell to the ground, and the fragments mixed with red water splashed all over the floor.
Xuejian's calves began to twist, and the fishy smell was like a living thing, drilling through her pores and into her blood vessels, trying to turn her into a part of this red hell. She subconsciously stepped back, but her heels hit the threshold, and she fell into the house in a panic.
"Mother..."
In the shadow of the house, Banxia was sitting on the edge of the Kang.
Through the occasional flash of pale lightning outside the window, Xuejian saw her son's face. Banxia didn't cry out for thirst like usual, nor did she cry like other children. He just looked out the window quietly, and his eyes, which were originally black and white, were actually glowing with a faint green light at this moment.
"Mom, the rain is sweet." Banxia stuck out her tongue and licked her lips, with a weird smile on her lips, "The grass is drinking blood, the trees are eating meat, and I'm hungry too."
"Stop talking! Stop talking!" Xue Jian rushed over like a madman and covered Banxia's mouth with her vine-covered left hand.
There was a sharp pain in the palm of my hand, it was the thorns on the vines digging into my flesh. But Xue Jian couldn't care less about the pain. She was horrified to find that as the red rain fell, the vines in her palm were crawling and growing crazily. Those tiny roots were like leeches smelling the fishy smell, scrambling to get into Banxia's skin.
"They are happy..." Banxia's voice leaked out from between her fingers, muffled, with a hint of age that did not belong to a child, "Mom, your grass is eating my flesh, and my flesh is feeding your grass. We... finally grew together."
Xue Jian retracted her hand as if she was electrocuted, and collapsed on the ground, breathing heavily.
Outside the window, thunder was rolling, like countless ghosts beating drums on the clouds. The red rain fell harder and harder, submerging the entire Yaowang Valley in blood.
The mass grave at the west end of the village was eerily quiet at the moment.
Qingdai held a black oil-paper umbrella and stood quietly in front of an ownerless grave.
The red rain hit the umbrella, making a muffled sound, as if someone was ringing a death knell in her ears. The rain ran down the edge of the umbrella, forming a red bead curtain around the umbrella, isolating her from this crazy world.
She looked down at the purple mushroom in front of her.
Under the water of red rain, this purple mushroom has completely grown crazy. It was no longer half as tall as yesterday. Instead, it expanded as if it had been blown out, reaching the height of an adult. The purple-black caps are stacked in layers, like a complex and gorgeous crown, and like a huge, beating heart.
Qingdai slowly squatted down, stretched out her hand with bright red nail polish, and gently stroked the rough surface of Zizhi.
It feels warm to the touch, and you can even feel liquid flowing underneath.
"Are you hungry too?" Qingdai murmured softly, with an imperceptible tremor in her voice.
She looked at this purple mushroom as if looking in a mirror.
This purple mushroom grows in this mass grave, sucking in the bones of the dead and drinking the blood of the living. It grows upward desperately, trying to break through the damn soil and see the outside world.
How much like herself.
Qingdai thought of her days in the city. Those high-rise buildings, those feasting and feasting, and those men wearing suits and leather shoes, talking about benevolence and morality but doing the business of eating people without spitting out their bones. Just like this Zizhi plant, she desperately took root in that reinforced concrete forest and desperately absorbed nutrients. Even if she changed beyond recognition, she still wanted to live and live better than anyone else.
title_en: Chapter 0009: Zi Zhi breaks the abdomen and the red rain washes the soul Chapter 0010: Listening to the music at the grave, people and ghosts are on the same journey
